description: This file is part of vtiger CRM and manages the editing of organizational field-level access permissions within the Settings module. It loads necessary utilities, retrieves field configurations, and renders a template for editing field visibility and permissions, specifically for different user profiles.

methods.name: getStdOutput
methods.description: Generates an array representing field labels and visibility permissions for a specific profile, used to construct the user interface for managing field-level access.
parameters: fieldListResult: mysql query result with field info
noofrows: number of rows in result
